system.description: An invisible field of energy surrounds you until you use a ten-hour recovery. This allows you to try blocking attacks with an eased Intellect defense roll instead of a Might defense roll; if you succeed, you reduce the severity of the wound by one step. Action. At tier 3: Your Intellect defense roll to block an attack is eased by two steps total.
